brands.evidence: Yes — Monzo is a real UK bank, not merely an app or a prepaid-card service.

client_claims.text: Monzo is authorised by the Prudential Regulation Authority (PRA) and regulated by the PRA and Financial Conduct Authority (FCA)
Eligible deposits are protected by the FSCS up to £120,000 per person
Its Financial Services Register number is 730427
client_claims.note: No fact covers the register number.
Legal entity name not in facts.

client_claims.text: You can receive your salary, set up Direct Debits and standing orders, make bank transfers, and use a sort code and account number
It provides current accounts, savings products, business banking, and other banking services
client_claims.note: Facts mention a savings rate but not the full product range.

client_claims.text: Monzo has no traditional high-street branches and is app-first
You also get a physical debit card for shops, online purchases, and cash machines
The FSCS limit is £120,000, not the more commonly cited £85,000 figure, because it reflects the current UK scheme limit
